name: Photo mode raises and lowers the camera through the director
body: Raising the camera for a photo currently snaps the lens to the player's eyes. Route it through the director so it blends in and out like any other shot, and sets the field of view to the one the framing test assumes.

comments.text: Done (D-141). The photo test still passes.

acceptance_criteria: C blends to the eye position over a short time
